name: Real Taiwa de Manabu Jissen Eikaiwa Summer Story
original_name: リアル対話で学ぶ実践英会話 SUMMER STORY
source:
A bilingual visual novel in Japanese and English for Japanese users who want to learn English.

Not only can players listen to spoken English, but they must actually speak English with proper pronunciation to advance through the game.

In the game, the player interacts — entirely in English — with three female college students who are studying abroad in Japan. The three students are Allison Lloyd (a quiet 21-year-old gardening fan from a London suburb), Charlotte Ryan (lively 20-year-old aspiring tour conductor from Sydney), and Elisabeth "Lisa" Ferguson (a 19-year-old anime fan from Florida). The character Karen M. Turner appears as the player's 26-year-old college English teacher from Yokohama.

[from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2011-04-28/square-enix-offers-ios-game-to-teach-english-dialogue]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
translation:
一款面向想学英语的日本用户的日英双语视觉小说。

玩家不仅能听英语口语，还必须用正确的发音实际说出英语才能推进游戏。

在游戏中，玩家全程用英语与三位在日本留学的女大学生互动。三位学生分别是：艾莉森·劳埃德（来自伦敦郊区的安静21岁园艺爱好者）、夏洛特·瑞安（来自悉尼的活泼20岁有志导游），以及伊丽莎白·"丽莎"·弗格森（来自佛罗里达的19岁动漫迷）。角色凯伦·M·特纳是玩家来自横滨的26岁大学英语老师。

[来自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2011-04-28/square-enix-offers-ios-game-to-teach-english-dialogue]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
